reasons: Status is correctly classified as a deviation: the cap exists and is mutual at 12 months' charges, but the $100,000 floor (vs. USD 1,000,000), the 'paid' only basis, the absence of confidentiality/data-protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP carve-outs, and the blanket exclusion of liability for loss of Customer records/data all fall short of the preferred position.

Redline is directionally correct and symmetrical: the floor is raised to $1,000,000 and the basis changed to 'paid or payable' in both the IBM cap (p0112) and the Customer cap (p0119), preserving mutuality as the rule requires.

Deleting the item excluding liability for 'loss of, or damage to, Customer's ... records or data' is within scope (detection guidance covers exclusion-of-damages language) and necessary in a hosting deal, since that exclusion is effectively a zero cap on the core risk.

New Section 9.3 supplies the required mutual Excluded Claims sentence (confidentiality/data protection/security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) plus the payment-obligations clarification, matching the model language without rewriting the surrounding section; changed-character ratios (~0.10) confirm a minimal edit.

Comment is accurate, cites the playbook position and offers the 12-months-fees fallback in the required tone; only minor caveat is to confirm the 'indemnification obligations under Section 8' cross-reference and any list renumbering after the deleted sub-item.
